product_metadata.title: DOWAN Large Mixing Bowls, Ceramic Serving Bowls, 3.2 Quart Deep Salad Bowls, 105 Oz White Fruit Bowls for Modern Home, Set of 2
features: Large Capacity: Dowan large serving bowls are 9.75"W/5" H, 3.2 Quarts(105 oz), good for serving big salad or a portion of pasta, fruits snacks, soup, rolls, mashed potatoes. Perfect for formal dining tables and halloween party

Decorative and Highly Functional: These 2 sets of large white bowls are beautiful and sturdy, wide opening, thick but not too heavy, this Ceramic mixing bowl is deep enough and will not overflow when you mixing salads

Unique Irregular Wave Design: Modern and elegant of these two sets ceramic salad bowls are a great addition to your kitchen and goes well with your other dishware, also perfect as a gift for housewarming, wedding, Christmas

Quality and Healthy: DOWAN insists on using top-grade porcelain, anti-scratch, anti-chip, lead-free, and cadmium-free. Large salad bowls are wash easily. Dishwasher/ microwave/ oven/ refrigerator safe
Stackable and Space-saving: The salad serving bowls are sturdy enough and smooth. And they are stackable with other tableware for easy storage
